Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

meet — to come together with someone. Example: Let's meet at eight.
friend — a person you like and know well. Example: I am meeting my friends.
weekend — Saturday and Sunday. Example: On Saturday I am meeting my friends.
restaurant — a place where you eat a meal. Example: Let's meet at the restaurant.
park — a public green place in a town. Example: We walk in the park.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Let's meet at ...
• What time?
• I am meeting ... on Saturday.
• See you there!
• It is near the park.
